tool_args.rationale: Fit the guided subcritical siphon and signed square-root local term numerically, allowing the full fallback parameter range. Fresh confirmation will test its predictive accuracy.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows identify the three-parameter square-root branch, which is supported by the monotone-concave signature and subtree guidance.
Pilot gradients remain below the specified supercritical gray zone, and the relevant probe is not available.
The verified siphon guidance accounts for gradient dependence that a substrate-only Haldane curve omits.
